items.title: Rebind missile fire to V and add HUD instruction row
establishes: The keydown switch in src/controls.js fires the onFire callback on 'KeyV' and no longer fires on 'KeyX'.
The .panel-controls div in index.html contains a row displaying 'V' and 'Fire Missile' so the player can see the binding in the HUD.

verification.selector: npm run dev → Start Flight → press V → cone missile spawns; press X → nothing happens

index.html .panel-controls contains a
with V and text 'Fire Missile'
